origins.section: A Backslash at the End of a Line Removes the Line Break and Nothing Else
Unicode Escapes Are Translated Before the Compiler Sees the Text Block
translateEscapes() Interprets Escapes in a String That Arrives at Run Time
Line Breaks in the Source Become \n Whatever the File Uses; Only an Escape Puts \r in the Value

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-space-after-backslash: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-space-after-backslash: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-space-after-backslash: Option c is decided by the page: 'One invisible space after it, and the file doesn't compile' (with the 'error: illegal escape character' output), and 'The compiler checks each backslash as it reads the literal, before stripping, and a backslash followed by a space is no escape.'
recorded.prompt:q-unicode-quotes: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unicode-quotes: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-unicode-quotes: Option b is decided by the page: 'The compiler translates every \uXXXX in the file into its character first, before it divides the source into tokens, so when it looks for the end of the block, the line holds three ordinary quotes.' The four errors are 'the four errors of the unescaped """' and the block closes mid-line.
recorded.prompt:q-translate-unicode: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-translate-unicode: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-translate-unicode: Option d is decided by the page: translateEscapes() 'throws IllegalArgumentException on anything else. That includes \u, since unicode escapes are not escapes of a literal: "Caf\\u00e9 %s".translateEscapes() fails with Invalid escape sequence'. The reference says it 'does not translate unicode escapes'.
recorded.prompt:q-crlf-source: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-crlf-source: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-crlf-source: Option a is decided by the page: 'Every CR LF of the file became a lone 0a. The compiler turns each line terminator inside a text block, whether CR LF, CR or LF, into LF before anything else, so the value doesn't depend on who saved the file. A format that requires CR LF, such as this bank file, HTTP headers or SMTP, gets it only from the \r escape.' The block therefore holds LF and can't equal the CR LF greeting on any machine.

recorded.prompt:q-space-after-backslash:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-space-after-backslash:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-space-after-backslash:a: Refuted: the page says the file doesn't compile ('illegal escape character') and that backslashes are checked 'before stripping', so both the join and the reason are wrong.
recorded.prompt:q-space-after-backslash:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-space-after-backslash:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-space-after-backslash:b: Refuted on the reason: 'The compiler checks each backslash as it reads the literal, before stripping', so the spaces are not stripped before the backslash is read. The outcome (illegal escape) is true.
recorded.prompt:q-space-after-backslash:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-space-after-backslash:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-space-after-backslash:d: Refuted on the outcome: 'One invisible space after it, and the file doesn't compile'. The summary repeats 'a space after the \ doesn't compile'. The reason is true.
recorded.prompt:q-unicode-quotes:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unicode-quotes:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-unicode-quotes:a: Refuted: the page shows the \u0022\u0022\u0022 line failing to compile with the same four errors as an unescaped """, and says unicode escapes are translated 'first, before it divides the source into tokens', not after the block's end is found.

recorded.outcome:q-unicode-quotes:c: Refuted on the reason: the page says unicode escapes are translated first and belong 'to the source text', unlike other escapes that 'are interpreted last'. The outcome (block ends mid-line) is true.

recorded.outcome:q-unicode-quotes:d: Refuted on the outcome: the page shows the line doesn't compile ('These are the four errors of the unescaped """'), so no value with three quotes is produced. The reason is true.
